items.title: Mila Kunis Jokes She's 'Made Out' With 2 of the Same Women as Ashton Kutcher
items.summary:
Mila Kunis is reminding fans that she and husband Ashton Kutcher shared kisses with a few of the same costars.

“There’s two women that both my husband and I have made out with,” Kunis, 43, said during a Wednesday, November 25, appearance on Kelly Ripa ’s “Let’s Talk Off Camera” podcast. “ Natalie Portman and Zoe Saldaña .”

“Those are good women to make out with,” Ripa, 56, quipped.

Kutcher and Saldaña, both 48, costarred in the romantic comedy Guess Who in 2005, sharing an onscreen kiss. The actor later locked lips with Portman, 45, in the 2011 rom-com No Strings Attached .

As for Kunis, the actress kissed Saldaña and Portman in the 2007 film After Sex and the 2010 psychological thriller Black Swan , respectively.

Ashton Kutcher’s Dating History: Mila Kunis, Demi Moore and More 

“Nat and I were really good friends,” Kunis said on Wednesday. “It’s uncomfortable because you want to laugh at the insanity. But you’re so comfortable with one another because you’re such close girlfriends. So there’s that weird level where you’re like, ‘What are we doing? We look like idiots.’”

Kunis began dating Kutcher in early 2012 , more than a decade after they starred together in That ’70s Show . They got engaged in February 2014 and welcomed daughter Wyatt that October. The couple tied the knot in July 2015 before welcoming their son, Dimitri, in November 2016.

Elsewhere on the podcast, Kunis recalled giving Kutcher a “second look” at the 2012 Golden Globes.

“I looked at him the first time in how many years and went, ‘Oh, he’s kinda hot,’” she shared.

Kunis and Kutcher stayed in…
items.t: Mila Kunis Jokes She's 'Made Out' With 2 of the Same Women as Ashton Kutcher

items.title: Tatyana Ali Laughs Off 'DWTS' Partner Jan Ravnik's F-Bomb on Live Show
items.summary:
Tatyana Ali has thoughts about hearing her Dancing With the Stars partner, Jan Ravnik , drop the F-bomb on live TV.

“I wasn’t that shocked,” Ali, 47, quipped while speaking with Extra after the Tuesday, November 24, finale. “He was just being real. It’s live TV, though.”

After Ali and Ravnik, 31, performed a stunning freestyle, the pro dancer was quickly censored when cohost Julianne Hough asked about his emotions. Ravnik said Ali “f***ing killed it” in the ballroom.

“It was just the perfect way to describe it, the last dance,” he told the outlet, defending his word choice.

Why Did ABC Censor Jan Ravnik After 'DWTS' Freestyle Routine?  

Ravnik choreographed Ali’s freestyle to “Minnie the Moocher” by Cab Calloway and “Over the Rainbow” by Judy Garland.

“Jan told me to tell him what my dream world was like, and he created this beautiful dance that’s a metaphor for my experience here,” Ali tearfully said from the skybox on Tuesday. “So it was fitting that it would be the last dance that we did.”

Ali and Ravnik finished season 35 in fourth place, with Ezra Frech and Daniella Karagach clinching the mirrorball trophy.

Despite narrowly missing a victory, Ali and Ravnik are grateful for their experience on the dance floor.

“There’s no goodbye, let’s stop talking about that,” he quipped to Extra , stressing they plan to remain friends.

Ali has previously been candid about her transformation in the ballroom.

Tatyana Ali Jokes Her Sons Aren't 'Impressed' by Her 'DWTS' Performances 

“I was a different size when I came here, but I loved my body then too,” she exclusively…

items.title: Brother of Hayden Panettiere's Ex Recalls Her Last Moments Before Death
items.summary:
The brother of Hayden Panettiere ’s on-off boyfriend Brian Hickerson is detailing the late actress’ final moments before her tragic death .

“I was not even supposed to be in Greenville that Sunday. I was supposed to go down to Atlanta to play golf,” Zach Hickerson began a Wednesday, November 25, interview with TMZ . “Upon learning that Hayden was like, ‘Absolutely not.’”

Walking into the South Carolina Airbnb where Panettiere and Brian, 37, were staying in August, Zach, 39, initially didn’t notice anything out of the ordinary.

“I didn’t think it was abnormal that she was [sitting], kind of, Indian-style and laid over,” he recalled. “Her hair was longer, so it was covering. I just assumed that she would pop up and be like, ‘Zachary, what are we doing today?’”

Brian Hickerson’s Brother Lays Out Timeline of Hayden Panettiere's Death 

According to Zach, he realized something felt “odd” when Panettiere didn’t eventually wake up.

“[Brian] took his hand and went, ‘Hayden,’ and when she didn’t immediately respond or make a noise or react, I stood up and moved to the side,” Zach told the outlet. “Brian … pulled her onto his chest, and when he did, I had a clear view of her face, [which] was pale, lips were purple. I immediately knew something was incredibly wrong.”

While Zach wasn’t aware that the Nashville alum was unconscious at the time, he decided to call 911 for medical assistance.

Jon Kopaloff/Getty Images

items.title: Elementary School Teacher Arrested for Allegedly Dealing Meth Out of Home
items.summary:
A New Jersey teacher and another person were arrested after they were accused of dealing meth out of a home.

The Phillipsburg Police Department announced in a press release on Friday, November 20, that John Schorb and Jennifer Paulus were arrested earlier that day as part of a joint narcotics investigation with the New Jersey State Police.

Officers executed a search warrant at a home in Phillipsburg on Friday around 6 a.m., according to an affidavit of probable cause obtained by NJ.com .

During the search, investigators found pills of suspected alprazolam on the living room coffee table and what appeared to be meth and other pills hidden throughout the home, including in the bedroom and kitchen, per the affidavit.

Fourth-Grade Teacher Arrested After Sexually Assaulting Girl, 9, in NJ 

Authorities reported finding other drugs and drug paraphernalia on the dining room table and in other areas. Additionally, white boxes labeled methylprednisolone that stored over two dozen white oval pills were found on the main floor of the house.

Police said that once the search was completed, Schorb, 44, and Paulus, 45, were detained on multiple drug-related charges that included possession of meth, possession of a controlled dangerous substance, possession of narcotic paraphernalia and distributing drugs within 1,000 feet of a school and within 500 feet of a public park.

Paulus worked as a fifth-grade teacher in the Phillipsburg School District at the time of her arrest, according to WFMZ .

She claimed to authorities that she did not know there were drugs in the home when she was…
items.t: Elementary School Teacher Arrested for Allegedly Dealing Meth Out of Home

items.title: Lady A’s Charles Kelley Shares Update on His Blood Cancer Treatment Plan
items.summary:
Lady A ’s Charles Kelley is feeling optimistic about his health as he approaches Thanksgiving .

“Hey y’all, just got back from my eighth treatment, and things are looking good,” Kelley, 45, shared via his Instagram Story on Tuesday, November 24. “The numbers are going the right way. I had a conversation about next steps and at some point, the conversation will be about stem cell transplant, and that’s pretty intense.”

The country singer continued, “You kind of just go in and kill out everything in your body and replace it with healthy stem cells that you harvest from your own stem cells. It’s quite the process, but it gives you the best chance of a long remission, and I think that’s what I want.”

In September, Kelley first revealed he was diagnosed with a blood cancer called multiple myeloma.

Lady A’s Charles Kelley Shares How His Journey to Sobriety Inspired Album 

According to the Mayo Clinic , multiple myeloma forms in plasma cells, a type of white blood cell. Treatment can help reduce complications and ease symptoms.

“I want to be able to get this thing and put it to the side for, heck, maybe five or 10 years of remission,” Kelley said in his latest social media update. “Maybe forever and throw something else at it down the road.”

Since sharing his diagnosis, the colead vocalist of the Grammy-winning trio has shared updates with his fans and followers about his health. In October, Kelley expressed gratitude for the strangers who came forward to share their survival stories.

That gratitude was shared once again in his latest video before the Thanksgiving…
items.t: Lady A’s Charles Kelley Shares Update on His Blood Cancer Treatment Plan

items.title: Death of Former Baseball Star and Actor Lance Broadway Takes Bizarre Turn
items.summary:
The mystery behind the sudden death of former Major League Baseball star Lance Broadway has deepened thanks to a new report.  

Broadway’s death has been listed as “unexplained,” according to a Dallas Police Department incident report obtained by the California Post on Tuesday, November 24.  

There are no signs that Broadway was under the influence of drugs or alcohol when his body was found in the stairwell of a Dallas apartment complex on November 17. He was 43.  

Police were called to the scene at 5:56 p.m., according to the report, and Broadway was formally pronounced dead at 6:20 p.m., per the Dallas County Medical Examiner. 

Ben Shelton Made Curious Comments About Trinity Rodman Before Reported Split 

Broadway’s cause of death remains undetermined, and results of his autopsy are still pending.  

A first-round pick of the Chicago White Sox in the 2005 MLB Draft, Broadway played three seasons with the White Sox and New York Mets.  

After retiring from baseball, Broadway found a career as an actor, appearing in the 2013 movie Olympus Has Fallen and TV shows like Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. , Lucifer and Colony .  

More recently, Broadway worked as a coach for Canes Southwest, a youth baseball organization.  

“For the past five years, our Canes baseball families had the privilege of experiencing firsthand the passion, intensity and unwavering commitment that defined Lance Broadway,” the organization said in a statement after his death. “There was no halfway with Lance. He was all in, all the time. His energy was unmatched, his expectations were high, and his work…
items.t: Death of Former Baseball Star and Actor Lance Broadway Takes Bizarre Turn

items.title: Child, 12, Discovers Mother and Her Boyfriend Dead in Apparent Murder-Suicide
items.summary:
A family tragedy occurred in San Antonio, Texas, when a 12-year-old child discovered that their mother and her boyfriend had died in an apparent murder-suicide that took place while several other adults and children slept inside the home.

Bexar County Sheriff’s deputies were called to a home around 3 a.m. on Wednesday, November 25, after they received reports of a shooting. Upon their arrival, authorities found a woman in her mid-30s and a man in his 40s dead upstairs.

A preliminary investigation was launched into the incident, and Bexar County Sheriff Javier Salazar said during a press conference that officials believe the woman shot her boyfriend before she died by suicide. However, Salazar stressed that those findings are preliminary as the investigation remains ongoing.

Salazar said that the couple worked at the same business. They apparently stopped to pick up fast food after they left work, and the shooting took place shortly after they returned home.

Texas Police Pursuit Ends in Murder-Suicide With Estranged Couple Dead 

Investigators believe the couple got into an argument shortly after they went upstairs, and the conflict quickly escalated.

“That food is still sitting there untouched,” Salazar said. “Whatever argument happened, it seems that it happened … within very quick succession and escalated very quickly.”

Authorities said that six adults and seven children, who ranged between 1 to 12 years old, were inside the home at the time of the murder-suicide. Salazar also noted that the home was cluttered, and clothing and miscellaneous items were scattered…
items.t: Child, 12, Discovers Mother and Her Boyfriend Dead in Apparent Murder-Suicide

items.title: Jenna Ushkowitz Says ‘Glee’ Was ‘Never the Same’ After Cory Monteith’s Death
items.summary:
Glee actress Jenna Ushkowitz found it especially difficult to mourn her costar Cory Monteith while filming the TV series.

“Well, the passing of Cory was just absolutely tragic and for a million reasons. The show itself was never the same. He was the heart of the show,” Ushkowitz, 40, said on the Tuesday, November 24, episode of the “We Need to Talk” podcast . “[He was] our friend, most importantly, and our leader. He really was the quarterback for us, he held everybody together.”

She continued, “He hosted parties for the crew, he was the kindest, he knew everybody’s names. He just was like such a good person, kind person. So, you know, that was just the worst.”

Monteith, who starred as quarterback Finn Hudson on Glee , died in July 2013 at the age of 31 after suffering an overdose.

'Glee' Stars Say 1 Episode Feels 'Morbid' After Cory Monteith's Death 

“When Cory passed, I think it brought us back together and glued us and we all were like, ‘Oh, it was existential of, like, life is short. Not just the show, not just this thing that’s going to expire, like life,’” Ushkowitz noted. “It brought us together in a really beautiful way, and nobody had the tools to deal with that, even our creators, like, they were dealing with grief too.”

In the wake of Monteith’s death, Glee wrote off Finn in a season 5 episode titled “The Quarterback,” which was filmed around five weeks after he died. ( Glee wrapped in 2015 after six seasons. Creators Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk and Ian Brennan are now developing a reboot .)

“To shoot ‘The Quarterback,’ I think it wasn’t the right thing,…
items.t: Jenna Ushkowitz Says ‘Glee’ Was ‘Never the Same’ After Cory Monteith’s Death

items.title: Ariana Grande Reacts to 'Insane' Backlash Over Her 'Petal' Music Video
items.summary:
Ariana Grande is addressing the “insane” backlash she received for her “Petal” music video.

“It’s just kind of like, ‘Oh, when will it be about the art? When will it be about the work?’” the pop star, 33, said on the Wednesday, November 25, episode of the “ Las Culturistas ” podcast. “That was largely what the video was about, is like, ‘Oh, here comes this girl, talented, little,’ and there’s always some distortion around the performance or around the art, whatever it is. And for a while she tries to accommodate and be valuable.”

Grande continued, “My favorite part is that she comes back to herself at the end. She’s wearing the same color. She’s wearing the same hair. She’s wearing the same thing. And then that’s when they say to her, ‘Oh, it’s just so weird. Go back to your old you.’ And she’s like, ‘I am. I found it. I connected with my inner — this is me. Wait, but I did. I did. This is it. This is me trying again. As me.’”

The music video for Grande’s song “Petal,” which premiered in July, portrayed the singer as an aspiring actress named Pepper, who repeatedly receives harsh critiques from male executives at Hollywood auditions. items.title: Woman Neglected Adopted Son Until He Needed Both Legs Amputated
items.summary:
A Missouri woman will be spending less than a year behind bars after she admitted to neglecting her adopted son who has spina bifida to the point that he needed both legs to be amputated.

Catiga Arnett was sentenced to six months in jail on November 16 after she pleaded guilty to a misdemeanor count of abuse or neglect of a disabled or vulnerable person.

Arnett, 56, learned her fate more than one year after authorities first learned about the case in March 2025. At the time, police responded to a call from a home in Noel, Missouri, on March 7, 2025, and found Arnett’s adopted son with deteriorating health, according to a probable cause affidavit viewed by Law & Crime .

Arnett’s son, whose age has not been revealed, was a paraplegic with the mental capacity of a 10-year-old child, according to the affidavit. Spina bifida “is a condition that happens when a baby’s spine and spinal cord don’t form properly in the womb. It’s a type of neural tube defect,” according to the Mayo Clinic . “Spina bifida can range from mild symptoms to serious disabilities. Symptoms depend on where on the spine the opening is found and how big it is.”

New Mexico Mom Let Her Disabled Teenage Daughter Slowly Starve to Death 

First responders said the son was found on the floor of his bedroom and he was only wearing an adult diaper.

The EMTs also said that the boy had a port for a colostomy bag, but the bag had not been installed. They went on to note that he had a catheter, “but the bag was empty with a calcified residue,” which indicated he had not urinated for “an extended period.”…

items.title: Miss Universe 2026 Makes History as 1st Mom and Married Woman to Win Pageant
items.summary:
Miss Puerto Rico Jennifer Barreto has been crowned Miss Universe 2026 , becoming the first mother to ever win the pageant.

Barreto, 27, was named the winner during the finals at Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on Tuesday, November 24. In addition to making history as the first mom to take the crown, Barreto is also the first married woman to win.

The victory comes three years after the Miss Universe organization lifted its ban on married women, mothers and pregnant women competing in the pageant.

Barreto, a psychologist and social worker, is married to U.S. Army Sergeant Yan Carlos Barreto Calderón . The couple share a daughter named Penélope, born in 2019.

After her victory, Barreto took to social media to express gratitude for her supporters. Additionally, she gushed about the bonds she formed with her fellow competitors.
